title: A Trip to the Mountains
text:
Our class visited the mountains last summer. The mountains are very high, and there is a long river in the valley. We walked near a small lake with clear water.

In the evening, we sat by the lake and watched the sun go down behind the hills. The sky was orange and red. Everyone agreed that the view was the best part of the trip.

questions.text: Where did the class go last summer?
What did the students watch in the evening?
What does the word 'valley' most likely describe?
How did the students probably feel about the trip?
options: They were tired of the view

vocabulary.definition: very high areas of land with steep sides
a low area of land between hills or mountains
a large area of water surrounded by land

paragraph_translations: Nasza klasa odwiedziła góry w zeszłym lecie. Góry są bardzo wysokie, a w dolinie płynie długa rzeka. Szliśmy obok małego jeziora z czystą wodą.
Wieczorem usiedliśmy nad jeziorem i patrzyliśmy, jak słońce zachodzi za wzgórzami. Niebo było pomarańczowe i czerwone. Wszyscy zgodzili się, że widok był najlepszą częścią wycieczki.
